in_sanskrit.name: Niroop
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory over illusion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Niroop एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'niroopa', meaning 'visible', 'manifest', or 'clear'. In Hindu mythology, Niroopa refers to the form of God Shiva that represents the triumph over illusion. This name is believed to inspire courage and wisdom in the bearer.
